description: This file defines the GrainInterfaceTypeResolver class, which associates grain interface types with their string representations in Orleans. It provides methods to get grain interface types based on provided interfaces, applies conventions, and handles generic type parameters.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceTypeResolver
classes.description: Provides mechanisms to resolve and associate grain interface types with their string representations, using providers and conventions, including handling of generic types.

methods.name: GetGrainInterfaceType
methods.description: Returns the GrainInterfaceType for a given interface Type, using providers and fallback conventions.

methods.name: GetGrainInterfaceTypeByConvention
methods.description: Generates a GrainInterfaceType based on default naming conventions, potentially modifying the name if it follows certain patterns.

methods.name: AddGenericParameters
methods.description: Augments a GrainInterfaceType with generic arguments if the interface is a constructed generic type and the initial type does not already include generic information.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The actual Type object to extract generic arguments from.
